attribution: Recitation by Mishary Rashid Alafasy, via Islamic Network (alquran.cloud)

verification.verifiedBy: Written confirmation from Islamic Network on its community forum, read 2026-10-26: thread "confirming acceptable use of per-user full-reciter downloads from the audio CDN" (https://community.islamic.network/d/310-confirming-acceptable-use-of-per-user-full-reciter-downloads-from-the-audio-cdn). Tarteel asked whether a per-user download of a whole reciter's ayah files from cdn.islamic.network is acceptable; reply by meezaan: "There are no restrictions for option b, but please be mindful of the rate limits if downloads will be multi-threaded." Also the terms at alquran.cloud/terms-and-conditions (section IV), read 2026-10-14. Attribution and caching were not addressed in the reply: the app credits the reciter and Islamic Network anyway. File URL still to be tested on a device
